§6Schrabidium Creation§f

§aMultiple paths to the iconic transuranic, from nuclear bombs to particle accelerators.§f

§bSchrabidium§f is a radioactive superactinide used for nuclear fuels, tools, armor, and exotic materials. Several methods exist, each with trade-offs.

§6Nuclear Explosion§f: Detonate near uranium ore. §e10%§f conversion to schrabidium ore, §e90%§f scorched (unusable). High yield but scars the terrain and can't be automated.

§6Dirty Bomb§f: Destroy a nuclear waste barrel with an explosive near uranium. §e1%§f conversion, cheap but unreliable. Enclose in concrete for safety.

§6Cyclotron§f: Bombard plutonium dust with ionized particles (fusion byproduct) for §e1 nugget§f. Contained but net power negative.

§6Higgs Boson Exposure§f (best): Expose §e8 uranium-238 ingots§f to a Higgs Boson capsule in the Exposure Chamber. Produces §e8 schrabidium ingots§f at §e100%§f efficiency. Requires a PA but automates well.

§6PUREX§f: Process depleted LEP ZIRNOX or MEP PWR fuel with §e250 mB§f schrabidic acid. Provides technetium as a bonus but requires fusion tech.

§cWARNING:§f Schrabidium is radioactive at §e15 RAD/s§f per ingot. Hold it without tier 3 hazmat and you'll go blind.
